title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting today for a routine follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well overall and denies any recent fatigue, edema, or changes in urinary output. He has been compliant with his current medications and maintains a stable weight. He expresses no concerns regarding his renal function at this time.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. Appearance is healthy. Vital signs are within normal limits. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema noted in lower extremities. Skin is warm and dry.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 2. The patient is currently stable and asymptomatic.

Plan
1. Continue current medication regimen as prescribed.
2. Order laboratory work including serum creatinine and GFR to monitor progression.
3. Patient instructed to maintain adequate hydration and follow up in six months for a repeat evaluation.
